mainEntity.name: How do I know whether an AI tool is worth paying for instead of just being another monthly expense?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Measure whether the workflow saves meaningful time or improves consistency after including setup, review, corrections, and maintenance. A tool is not valuable simply because it generates an impressive draft.

For a solopreneur, useful measures include hours avoided, response time, completed follow-ups, publishing consistency, fewer missed steps, or lower revision effort. Run My AI Biz encourages practical testing rather than treating demonstrations or bot examples as guaranteed revenue-producing businesses.

Key factors:
- Baseline time before implementation
- Quality and accuracy of outputs
- Frequency of the task
- Ongoing supervision required

Record the task’s manual duration for several repetitions, then compare it with AI-assisted duration and correction time. Also track whether the workflow creates new problems, such as inaccurate claims, broken links, or inconsistent brand language.

Run My AI Biz can help frame AI as an operating experiment with clear limits rather than an automatic income promise.
acceptedAnswer.description: Compare total time saved and quality gained with subscription, integration, review, and maintenance costs. Track a baseline, test several real tasks, and stop paying when the workflow does not improve a meaningful bottleneck.
